summary: All planned changes are implemented and committed in commit aac626ea2. The new constant _CI_DOCKER_PERMANENT_PULL_ERROR_MARKERS (7 markers: access denied, denied:, no such image, manifest unknown, not found, unauthorized, repository does not exist) is defined at pr_monitor.py:797-805. The helper _evidence_line_is_permanent_pull_failure checks the evidence line itself and adjacent daemon-error lines within the timeout-evidence window, returning True for permanent errors (pr_monitor.py:1021-1038). _log_shows_docker_registry_timeout is modified to build transient_evidence_line_indexes by filtering permanent evidence lines, with an early-return if none remain (pr_monitor.py:1117-1123), and the final proximity any() uses transient_evidence_line_indexes instead of evidence_line_indexes (pr_monitor.py:1148-1151). evidence_line_set is left unchanged so the uncorroborated-proximity guard still functions correctly. All 3 new tests are present in test_pr_monitor_part_003.py (lines 1350, 1378, 1406): access-denied, no-such-image, and manifest-unknown scenarios each assert ReportCiFailure. The existing test_docker_pull_failed_wording_anchors_request_canceled_rerun regression (line 231) is preserved and the logic analysis confirms it still passes: request-canceled is not a permanent marker so that evidence line survives into transient_evidence_line_indexes. Full AWF/CI validation is managed by AWF after agent completion.
